Aggregate Age Structure of a Model Output Object

aggregate_age_structure.Rd

Aggregates a long-format data frame with an age dimension (dim1) into custom age groups. Supports sum, mean, weighted.mean, and rate-based aggregation with optional plotting check.

Usage

aggregate_age_structure(
  obj,
  age_breaks,
  method = c("sum", "mean", "weighted.mean", "rate"),
  weights = NULL,
  time_var = "dim4",
  tol = 0.000001
)

Arguments

obj

A data frame with at least the columns dim1 and value. If using time-varying weights, must also include a time column (default: dim4).

age_breaks

A numeric vector of breakpoints defining age bands (e.g. c(0, 1, 5, ..., Inf)).

method

One of "sum", "mean", "weighted.mean", or "rate". "rate" returns population-weighted rate while preserving total events.

weights

A numeric vector or data frame of population weights, required for "rate" and "weighted.mean".

time_var

The name of the time column. Default is "dim4".

tol

Numerical tolerance for preservation check. Default is 1e-6.

Value

A data frame with aggregated dim1 values. If method = "rate", a plot is attached as an attribute.
